value_kind_registry.semantic_version_string: STRING matching MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no wildcard.
value_kind_registry.qualified_identifier: Lowercase dot-separated identifier resolved under namespace rules.
value_kind_registry.type_expression: One built-in or defined type, including declared type arguments.
value_kind_registry.value_expression: Expression producing a material value or a permitted special sentinel.
value_kind_registry.value_or_object_expression: Inline value expression or indented lowercase-key object value.
value_kind_registry.target_expression: REFERENCE, PATH, URI, GLOB, or material value accepted by the operation contract.
value_kind_registry.selector_expression: REFERENCE, PATH, URI, GLOB, or homogeneous LIST/SET of selectors.
value_kind_registry.boolean_expression: Expression statically producing BOOLEAN or UNKNOWN under special-value rules.
value_kind_registry.source_expression: PATH, URI, or REFERENCE to declared source data.
value_kind_registry.ordered_value: INTEGER, DECIMAL, STRING, DATE, TIME, DATETIME, DURATION, BYTES, PERCENTAGE, or same-unit MEASURE.
value_kind_registry.boolean: One exact BOOLEAN value: TRUE or FALSE.
value_kind_registry.side_effect_declaration: Exactly the BOOLEAN FALSE, meaning the possible effect set is exactly none, or one LIST of one or more distinct concrete effect classes drawn from built_in_groups_and_results_v0.1.0.json#/enum_groups/effect_classes excluding none.
value_kind_registry.dependency_class_list: One LIST of one or more distinct dependency classes drawn from built_in_groups_and_results_v0.1.0.json#/enum_groups/dependency_classes; declared_state_only is exclusive and never appears with another member.
value_kind_registry.boolean_or_reference_list: A boolean_expression or a possibly empty LIST containing only REF values whose targets evaluate to BOOLEAN or UNKNOWN.
value_kind_registry.nonnegative_numeric_or_measure: An INTEGER or DECIMAL greater than or equal to zero, or a MEASURE whose numeric component is greater than or equal to zero.
value_kind_registry.operation_identifier: A core_operation_ids member or the identifier of a DEFINE declaration whose KIND is kind.operation.
value_kind_registry.operation_identifier_or_handler_referenc: One REF resolving to HANDLER, or one operation_identifier that registers no required named parameter and whose required target, if any, is supplied by the handler-context binding.
value_kind_registry.property_path: One property path made of one or more SIMPLE_IDENTIFIER segments separated by '.'.
value_kind_registry.schema_reference_or_nested_schema: One REF resolving to a defined OBJECT type, or a local nested sequence of one or more FIELD blocks.
value_kind_registry.sha256_string: A STRING containing 'sha256:' followed by exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
value_kind_registry.string_uri_or_evidence_reference: One STRING, URI, or REF resolving to EVIDENCE.
value_kind_registry.type_or_format_base: For DEFINE kind.type, one TYPE_EXPRESSION or one REF resolving to DEFINE kind.type; for DEFINE kind.format, one qualified_identifier(format).
